description:
Priority: P0 (correctness). File: .github/workflows/on-push.yml. Reference: hare (also aviary/keystore/metricstore).

Problem: Trigger is `branches: ['**', '!trunk']`, missing the `!gh-readonly-queue/**` exclusion every mature sibling has. Without it the fast "⚡ PR Ready" job can run on merge-queue branches and satisfy the queue's required status check BEFORE the heavy on-merge.yml build finishes — allowing a failing commit to merge.

Change: Add the third branch exclusion plus explanatory comment:
  on:
    push:
      branches:
        - '**'
        - '!trunk'
        - '!gh-readonly-queue/**'   # on-merge.yml owns merge-queue validation

Acceptance: on-push.yml does not run on gh-readonly-queue/* refs; comment explains why (copied from hare).
Note: carnegie shares this exact gap; apply the same fix there (tracked separately).
title: [TPL-001] Add the merge-queue branch guard to on-push.yml
